title: Telfer Tree — Main Family Line
body_markdown:
# 🌲 Telfer Tree

> **The main line.** From Scottish immigrant Francis Telfer (~1809) through to Mark, Kylie, and the kids.

```
[[Francis Telfer (1809–1895)|Francis Telfer]] (~1809–1895) ← Scottish immigrant, *Prince George* 1838
  └── + [[Margaret Wright Telfer (?–1892)|Margaret Wright]] (third wife)
        └── [[John Telfer (1847–1929)|John Telfer]] (1847–1929) + [[Caroline Amelia Telfer (1842–1929)|Caroline Amelia Masters]] (1842–1929)
              └── [[Francis Charles Telfer (1875–1954)|Francis Charles "Charlie" Telfer]] (1875–1954) + [[Amy Ellen Telfer (1884–1951)|Amy Ellen Provis]] (1884–1951)
                    └── [[Murray John Telfer (1924–2009)]] (1924–2009)   ◄── 9th of 10 kids
                          └── + [[Shirley Edna Telfer (1929–2017)|Shirley Edna Parker]] (1929–2017)
                                ├── [[Daryll William Telfer]]
                                ├── [[John Robert Telfer|John Robert Telfer]]
              │     ├── + [[Robyn Telfer]] (wife)
              │     ├── [[Angela Telfer]] (adopted)
              │     ├── [[Peter Telfer]] (adopted)
              │     └── [[Carissa Telfer (?–2023)]] (adopted, † 29 Jun 2023)
              ├── [[Grantley Keith Telfer|Grantley Keith Telfer]]
              │     ├── [[Kristin Stefanoff|Kristin Telfer]] (m. Ben Stefanoff, Nairne SA)
              │     ├── Jono Telfer
              │     └── Nick Telfer
              ├── ★ [[Timothy Neil Telfer (1959–?)]] (Dad)
              │     ├── + [[Penny Telfer]] (biological mother of his children)
              │     │     ├── [[Mark Kenneth Telfer (1986–?)|Mark Kenneth Telfer]] (b. 21 Mar 1986)
              │     │     │     └── + [[Kylie Isabella Telfer (1982–?)|Kylie Isabella Dance]] (m. 12 Mar 2016)
              │     │     │           ├── [[Mitchell Telfer (2008–?)|Mitchell Telfer]] (b. 28 May 2008 — Crystal Rose McDonald)
              │     │     │           ├── [[Levi Leonard Timothy Telfer (2017–?)|Levi Leonard Timothy Telfer]] (b. 31 Jan 2017)
              │     │     │           └── [[Zabella Violet Zelda Telfer (2019–?)|Zabella Violet Zelda Telfer]] (b. 19 Feb 2019)
              │     │     ├── [[Amy Nicole Telfer]] (Redcliffe QLD)
              │     │     └── [[David Telfer]] (half-brother, lives Rockhampton)
              │     └── + [[Sheryle Telfer (1961–?)]] (m. 28 Aug 1999) → [[Wedding - Tim & Sheryle Telfer (28 Aug 1999)|💍]]
              │           ├── + [[Paul Ivory (1955–1996)]] (1955–24 Dec 1996, aged 41, suicide — Sheryle's first husband)
              │           │     ├── [[Aaron Ivory]] (step-brother, Sheryle & Paul's son)
              │           │     ├── [[Jared Ivory]] (step-brother)
              │           │     ├── [[Lauren Ivory]] (step-sister)
              │           │     └── [[Joel Ivory]] (step-brother, lives in China)
              ├── [[Kathryn Mavis Telfer (1961–1965)]] (deceased)
              └── [[Susan Shirley Lawrie|Susan Shirley Lawrie]] (née Telfer)
```

## ⚠️ Earlier Generations — Confirmed
> **Furthest confirmed:** [[John Telfer (of Castleton)]] + [[Elspeth Young]] (James Telfer's parents, baptised James 14 Jul 1761 at Castleton OPR). Further back is unconfirmed.

```text
[[John Telfer (of Castleton)]] (~1715–1735?) + [[Elspeth Young]]
  └── [[James Telfer (1761–1845)]] + Betty Hutton (1776–1853)
        └── [[Francis Telfer (1809–1895)]] + Margaret Wright
              └── [[John Telfer (1847–1929)]] + Caroline Amelia Masters
```

> **Scottish records needed:** Castleton OPR registers (FamilySearch batch C11865-1, microfilm 1067953) contain baptisms from 1749. John Telfer (~1715–1735) would need a search of the full Castleton OPR (1697–1819) via ScotlandsPeople (£) or FamilySearch.
